entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-02-03
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • First call to workspace/symbol using roslyn-language-server tool always returns no result #82275
  • Missing sequence points for non-Task/ValueTask-returning methods in Runtime Async #82274
  • `AssertContainingContextIsForThisCreation` fails for indexer with interpolation handler in object initializer #82273
  • Proposal: FAWMN generator chaining #82271
  • Generated IL for InlineArray in `record class` vs. `class` #82270
  • Skip CodeGenClosureLambdaTests.InvalidGotoLiftingBetweenGotoAndLabel4 #82268
  • Reduce allocations in ProjectChanges #82265
  • Spreading to an immutable collection yields unwanted results #82264
  • cch11 #82262
  • New extension methods fails to provide the inline documentation and navigation (goto definition) fails (package references). #82258

Closed

  • roslyn-language-server on linux hits inotify limits #82198
  • roslyn-language-server package needs a readme #82200
  • https://github.com/dotnet/roslyn/issues/new/choose #82259
  • CS9282 reported for readonly static property on generic type #82239

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix workspace search always returning no results for first query #82276
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Implement LSP Call Hierarchy support #82272
    VSCode
  • Merge branch 'main' into features/UnsafeEvolution #82267
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, VSCode, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Optimize ProjectChanges for cases when there are no changes #82266
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Avoid eliding nested pointer-to-ref conversions #82263
    Area-Compilers
  • Improve logging in unit testing work coordinator #82257
    Area-IDE, VSCode

Merged

  • Limit the FileSystemWatchers to one per drive root for DefaultFileChangeWatcher #82211
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode, Next
  • Add README to roslyn-language-server NuGet package #82201
    Next
  • Skip CodeGenClosureLambdaTests.InvalidGotoLiftingBetweenGotoAndLabel4 #82269
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Unsafe evolution: check overrides and implementations #82172
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Don't do any RID filtering in Microsoft.CA.LanguageServer #82256
    Area-Infrastructure, Next

Updated

  • Extension indexers: adjust ref analysis for setter #82218
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Indexers
  • Fix sequence point and instrumentation issues with runtime async #82236
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Runtime Async
  • Do not show file-based program completions when the VS Code setting is disabled #82214
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Closed classes 2 #82052
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Closed Class Hierarchies
  • Fix Generate Type to respect existing file namespace #82167
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Improve elimination of redundant evaluations during pattern matching operation #82142
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Pattern Matching
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 2894799 #82243
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Hot Reload External Access: Add API for updating multiple projects #82240
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Detect changes in non-Roslyn projects and report them as rude edits #82225
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Enable generate type for unresolved types in XML doc comment cref attributes #82194
    Area-IDE, VSCode
